findings.component: caption line of the petition, the proposed order and the notice component
findings.renderedText: IN THE MUNICIPAL COURT OF CASS COUNTY, STATE OF NORTH DAKOTA
findings.defect: On the two municipal-route variants the caption names a court that does not exist. North Dakota municipal courts are city courts, established by and named for a municipality under N.D.C.C. ch. 40-18; there is no municipal court of a county. The caption composer appends 'OF <COUNTY> COUNTY' unconditionally, so selecting the municipal court type yields 'THE MUNICIPAL COURT OF CASS COUNTY'. The fixture itself identifies the municipality — its ordinance citation is 'Fargo Municipal Code § 8-0301' — so the city is available and is not used. The district-route packets are unaffected because for them the county name is correct.
findings.correctionOwner: implementation correction — the North Dakota packet module, owned by the custom_pleading lane (shard B). Not fixture data: the fixture supplies both the municipal court type and the city. Not the shared renderer: the shared layout prints {{courtLine}} verbatim and the courtLine string is composed inside the jurisdiction module.
findings.location: src/lib/rcap/packets/jurisdictions/north-dakota/custom-pleading.ts:649, :846 and :963 — `IN ${ND_COURT_PHRASE[courtType].toUpperCase()} OF ${countyName.toUpperCase()} COUNTY, STATE OF NORTH DAKOTA`, with ND_COURT_PHRASE defined at :175-178.
findings.note: Recorded as an observation rather than as this job's disposition. The disposition is held_on_source_or_design because the review manifest does not describe the current packet set; a correction disposition on this family belongs to the re-review that follows a regenerated manifest.

heldOn.detail: The manifest's participantPacketProof.sourceManifestSha256 does not match the current packet-proof file, and the manifest embeds only the 5 canonical packets while the current proof records 9 (5 canonical and 4 regression variants). The four required technical variants — nd-dui-seal-municipal-ordinance-2, nd-marijuana-seal-thc-grams-2, nd-misdemeanor-seal-municipal-court-2 and nd-felony-seal-no-restitution-ordered-2 — are absent from the manifest entirely. The packet proof was regenerated with the variants after the review manifest was generated, and the manifest was not regenerated with it.
heldOn.notStale: The implementation is not stale. The module and verifier hashes recorded in the proof, recorded in the manifest and present on disk are identical, and all 9 packets regenerate byte-identically against the current proof.
